evidence: LOCAL TEST REQUIRED: Tab through all navigation and service controls; save screenshot as docs/screenshots/issue-01.png
user_impact: Users who cannot use a mouse may be blocked from navigation or service access.
recommended_fix: Make every interactive function reachable and operable with keyboard input alone.

evidence: LOCAL TEST REQUIRED: capture a visible focus state while tabbing; save docs/screenshots/issue-02.png
user_impact: Keyboard users may lose track of their current position on the page.
recommended_fix: Provide a strong, consistently visible :focus-visible style for interactive controls.

evidence: LOCAL INSPECTION REQUIRED: inspect search and form controls in DevTools/accessibility tree; save docs/screenshots/issue-03.png
user_impact: Screen-reader users may not understand what an unlabeled control does.
recommended_fix: Use explicit labels or appropriate accessible names for inputs, buttons and controls.

evidence: LOCAL INSPECTION REQUIRED: inspect headings/landmarks and capture docs/screenshots/issue-04.png
user_impact: Assistive-technology users depend on semantic structure for efficient navigation.
recommended_fix: Use semantic landmarks and a logical heading hierarchy with meaningful section names.

evidence: LOCAL INSPECTION REQUIRED: inspect meaningful images and capture docs/screenshots/issue-05.png
user_impact: Users who cannot see images may miss information conveyed only visually.
recommended_fix: Provide meaningful alternative text for informative images and empty alt for decorative images.
